spl_product_data_elements: Itch Relief Diphenhydramine HCl CAMPHOR (NATURAL) POVIDONE TROMETHAMINE GLYCERIN WATER ALCOHOL ALOE VERA LEAF DIPHENHYDRAMINE HYDROCHLORIDE DIPHENHYDRAMINE
indications_and_usage: ​Uses for the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with: minor burns minor cuts scrapes insect bites minor skin irritations
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Flammable: Keep away from fire or flame. ​Do not use on large areas of the body on chicken pox, poison ivy, or sunburn on broken, blistered, or oozing skin more often than directed with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one taken by mouth ​When using this product avoid contact with the eyes ​Stop use and ask doctor if conditions worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days ​Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away.
Flammable: Keep away from fire or flame.
do_not_use: ​Do not use on large areas of the body on chicken pox, poison ivy, or sunburn on broken, blistered, or oozing skin more often than directed with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one taken by mouth
when_using: ​When using this product avoid contact with the eyes
stop_use: ​Stop use and ask doctor if conditions worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: ​Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away.
dosage_and_administration: ​Directions adults and children 2 years of age and older: spray on affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily children under 2 years of age: do not use, consult a doctor
other_safety_information: ​Other information store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) shake well before use pump must be primed before use
inactive_ingredient: ​ ​Inactive ingredients SD ALCOHOL 40-B, WATER, GLYCERIN, CAMPHOR, TROMETHAMINE, PVP, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE
